scope: Jest Circus, one Jest project with the default Expo environment, --runInBand, Seshat workers 1 and 2

cli.originalLimit: The stock 3000 ms fixture deadline expired during coverage before mutation. A focused 10000 ms control completed coverage in 3056 ms and returned timed-out, not-run.
cli.reuseReason: The review fixes change only the Jest adapters and checks; the CLI scenarios use the Node runner.

limits: Local Linux x64 source executable; native package/platform CI and fresh review are separate.
No whole-file test selection changes from issue #181.

reviewFix.finding: Errors Jest adds at test_done, such as expect.assertions counts, were counted as unattributed on a test that had already failed, giving execution-error where main gave killed.
Jest replaces errors named AssertionError (node:assert, chai) at test_done, so matching error objects missed them and gave execution-error where main gave killed.
